description: A function that returns JSX. Used as a tag: `<Profile />`.
JSX treats `<lowercase>` as an HTML tag and `<Capitalized>` as a component reference.
Components must be declared at module level. A component declared inside another is recreated on each render and loses its state.
`export default function A()` is imported as `import A from`; `export function B()` is imported as `import { B } from`.
